name: v0.3.47 — Steals in-app (web) with scroll + search fixed
releaseNotes:
• Steals is back in-app with the full latest experience — the spec search, the date-sorted “Fresh Steals” feed, and “new steals found” alerts — now that scrolling and the search button work properly.
• All in-app web screens (Reports, Steals, Stores, Rewards, Guacanomics, GuacWizard) respond to touch correctly.
• Dashboard icon menu + raised active tab included.
